packet.description:
Return Path offers a suite of cloud-based products that ensure email campaign optimization and message deliverability. Return Path helps commercial email senders get more email delivered to the inbox. Our tools and services give senders the insight and resources to diagnose and prevent email deliverability and rendering failures by improving and maintaining their email sending reputations.

Return Path was acquired by Validity

original_record.rationale: The description specifies conventional email campaign optimization and deliverability diagnostics focused on inbox placement, rendering failures and sender reputation.
